mdvlcraft:malevolent_kitchen.title: Malevolent Kitchen
mdvlcraft:malevolent_kitchen.description: Unlocks Malevolent Kitchen (10 mana a second, 180 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
mdvlcraft:malevolent_kitchen.extra_description: Cast, then cast again within 3 s to switch between the closed and open Malevolent Shrine; it opens at maximum output. It costs 10 mana a second while it stands. Hold the cast key to cut every mob nearby (unseen slashes); sneak and cast to close it.

mdvlcraft:chop.title: Chop
mdvlcraft:chop.description: Unlocks Chop (14 mana, 1 s cooldown) on the ability wheel. Hold the cast key to keep casting each time it is ready
mdvlcraft:chop.extra_description: Dismantle: a fast cutting slash at what you look at. Cast while sneaking for the chanted Calamitous Shrine Dismantle, a flip that sends a great cut.

mdvlcraft:mince.title: Mince
mdvlcraft:mince.description: Unlocks Mince (24 mana, 5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel. Hold the cast key to keep casting each time it is ready
mdvlcraft:mince.extra_description: Cleave: a cut that adapts to the target's toughness and strength.

mdvlcraft:sear.title: Sear
mdvlcraft:sear.description: Unlocks Sear (30 mana, 40 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
mdvlcraft:sear.extra_description: Divine Flame: loose Cursed Fate's flaming arrow where you look; it bursts into fire on what it hits.

mdvlcraft:dicing_board.title: Dicing Board
mdvlcraft:dicing_board.description: Unlocks Dicing Board (36 mana, 20 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
mdvlcraft:dicing_board.extra_description: The Calamitous Shrine's Enhanced Spiderweb: a web of cuts spreads across the ground around you, slicing everything caught in it.

mdvlcraft:sparking_bloodlust.title: Sparking Bloodlust
mdvlcraft:sparking_bloodlust.description: Unlocks Sparking Bloodlust (36 mana, 45 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
mdvlcraft:sparking_bloodlust.extra_description: Roar like the Feral Claw: for 15 s your attack speed rises by 30% and each strike has a one-in-five chance to be a Black Flash (2.5x damage and a short stun).

mdvlcraft:bull_rush.title: Bull Rush
mdvlcraft:bull_rush.description: Unlocks Bull Rush (24 mana, 10 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
mdvlcraft:bull_rush.extra_description: Charge forward with your shoulder; the first creature you meet takes 1.5x your attack damage and blacks out, staggered like a Punishment Kick.
